implementation_directives: Use current Indiana parcel boundaries as primary geometry; retain older parcel services only as historical evidence.
Keep NOAA NWPS observed stage first and USGS Water Data as observed fallback; preserve qualifier P.
NFHL is effective/insurance reference; BAFM is planning/Indiana Flood Control Act reference. Never merge them in UI or policy.
Acquire 3DEP terrain through TNMAccess/LidarExplorer; derive Terrain-RGB through gdalwarp/rio-rgbify and serve via PMTiles/XYZ/Martin without bulk source data in Git.
Use Indiana Current Imagery for the photorealistic twin surface and real 3DEP Terrain-RGB for terrain; no synthetic production terrain.
HEC-RAS mesh targets are nominal engineering refinement bands: channel 25-50 ft, near berm/structures/LAG 25-40 ft, active floodplain 50-100 ft, overbank/ag 100-200 ft.
HEC-RAS outputs must be SIMULATION_DEMO or MODEL_OUTPUT EvidenceArtifacts with SHA-256 provenance and human_review_required governance.
NLD is read-only evidence and does not automatically accredit levees.
